<includeonly>You can [https://ghul.dev/rosetta/{{lc:{{#titleparts:{{{1}}}|1}}}} edit and run this online] in the ghūl playground.</includeonly><noinclude>
Links a ghūl solution to its page on [https://ghul.dev/rosetta/ ghul.dev], where the ghūl playground fetches it from the solution repository and runs it in the reader's browser.

The parameter is the solution's path: a task's slug, or a slug and a part for a task solved more than one way. The page shows every part of a task, so only the slug is used.
